_note: t = sliderValue / 127; if t < 0 blend frame0 -> minFrame by -t, else frame0 -> maxFrame by t. Scale at slider 0 is exactly 1.000. Multiply the per-slider scales together, THEN multiply by _baseCorrection.
_baseCorrectionNote: frame 1, applied to every character regardless of slider values (SPEC 6-1-1). _baseCorrection is a scale multiplier; _baseCorrectionPos is a position delta to add.
